name: @usenami/graph-snapshot
description: Reads Uniswap V3 market data from The Graph, verifies the indexer attestation (response bytes, deployment, signer, on-chain allocation), assembles a canonical signable snapshot and applies the rule that follows from it, and refuses a signature request for an agent that does not resolve to a registered human. Signature SUBMISSION is not implemented: signing the snapshot needs an enclave data key that is not provisioned here.
